meta.title: ALpA-Smart ATS Developer API Catalog
meta.purpose: Single file for building a new job-board scraper app: platforms, board tokens, how to send LIST requests, and what the list response contains. Speed-first: board-token list fetch only — never visit each job URL for details.

allowed: One (or paginated) HTTP GET per board_token using request.list_url_template
Parse jobs from the list response only
Keep absolute_url as a link for users — do not scrape it
Store description HTML/text only when already present on the list response
forbidden: HTTP GET of each job's absolute_url / career detail page for HTML or text
Inventing missing fields (skills, remote, salary, etc.)
scraping_policy.can_board_list_provide_details: Sometimes yes: platforms with description_from_list=true often include description (or rich fields) in the board list response. When description_from_list=false, you still get title/url/location/etc. from the list — just not a full description body.

steps: Pick a platform object under platforms.<slug>.
Iterate board_tokens (or example_board_tokens for a quick test).
Build list_url_template by replacing {board_token} (and {offset}/{page} if paginated).
Send HTTP GET with request.headers (public boards — usually no auth).
Parse response using response.jobs_path and response.field_mapping.
If response.description_from_list is true, map description fields when present; otherwise leave content_* blank.
Never fetch absolute_url for each job.
Normalize into unified_output_schema. Leave missing fields null/blank.
Respect concurrency.global / concurrency.per_host_token to avoid HTTP 429.

url_placeholders.{job_id}: Job id from list response (for URL patterns only — not for detail scraping)

how_to_use.minimal_python_example:
import json, urllib.request
cat = json.load(open('ats_developer_api_catalog.json'))
p = cat['platforms']['breezy_hr']
token = p['example_board_tokens'][0]
url = p['request']['list_url_template'].format(board_token=token)
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=p['request']['headers'])
print(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read()[:500])
# Stop here: parse the list JSON. Do not request each job URL.

unified_output_schema.description: Normalize fields from the board LIST response only. Never HTTP-fetch absolute_url / job detail pages for HTML or text. If a field is missing on the list response, leave it null/blank.

absolute_url.description: Public job link for humans/UI only. Do NOT scrape this URL for description HTML/text.

content_html.description: Only if already present on the list response; otherwise null

content_text.description: Only if already present on the list response; otherwise null

response.notes: Careers list endpoint returns titles/locations; usually no full description. Leave description blank — do not open each job URL.
Public boards API; content=true includes HTML job descriptions in the list response. Use list only — do not open each job URL.
List response is metadata-light (title, location, dates, URL). Do NOT fetch per-job detail URLs for descriptions — leave description blank.
List includes descriptionHtml when available. Use list only — do not open each job URL.

breezy_hr.label: Breezy HR

notes: The documented v3 REST API (`https://api.breezy.hr/v3/company/<token>/positions`) requires a **Bearer access token** and returns `missingAccessToken` without one — do not use this for public scraping.
The `/json` endpoint is the public, unauthenticated feed intended for embedding job widgets and is the correct choice here.
